jobs.title: AI Engineer l Young Talent Program
jobs.jd: The rules of building are being rewritten. Come write them with us. Every few decades, the way companies are built gets reinvented from scratch. That is happening right now, and the people who learn to build in this new world first will define the next twenty years. Superstars are being made this year, not in ten. HelloPrint is a €100M+ e-commerce company serving businesses across Europe and the US. We are rebuilding the entire company as AI-first: our platform, customer service, operations, and how we design, price, sell, and deliver. Every piece of technology we run is being rewritten as we speak. We are doing it with a small, senior, very fast AI development team working shoulder to shoulder with our business leads. Now we are opening a handful of seats for young builders who want to grow faster than any graduate scheme, bootcamp, or big-tech ladder could ever let them. We don't care if you are 16, 25 or 30, whether you are self-taught, hacking in high school, or finishing a degree at TU Delft or TU/e—we care about what you have built and how fast you solve hard problems. The HelloPrint AI Residency is how you start. It is a permanent role from day one: your first year is a structured residency where you rotate across our most important AI projects, build alongside the team and learn at full speed. After that, you keep growing - in the direction where you have the most impact. What you will actually do: You will not get a training plan, a sandbox project or six months of shadowing. From week one, you build real things that real customers and colleagues use, on the projects that matter most to the company. You sit next to the founders, next to the engineers who are rebuilding our platform, and next to the business leads who own the outcomes. You get a lot of freedom and real responsibility, plus honest, direct guidance and feedback from people who have built this before. The kind of work you could be on in your first months: Agentic Commerce : making HelloPrint discoverable and orderable through AI assistants, so a customer can order business cards from inside a chat. AI Design Studio : letting customers create a print-ready design from a single sentence. AI-first customer service : replacing classic ticketing with agents that resolve questions, check artwork and handle orders end to end. Internal agent swarms : automating finance, purchasing, pricing and operations work that today still takes people hours. Whatever you spot next : if you see something we should build, you pitch it, and if it is good, you build it. We work with almost every modern framework and model, and we change our tools the moment something better appears. You will ship, measure, throw away and ship again - every week. Who you are: You are a builder before anything else . You have shipped things nobody asked you to build: an app, an agent, a bot, a tool your friends actually use, a side business, an open-source contribution, a weird experiment that taught you something. You probably have more GitHub commits, demos or deployed projects than most people twice your age. You are extremely curious and extremely critical. You read the new model release the day it drops and try it that evening. You question every assumption, including ours, and you can explain why. You are never satisfied with "it works" — you want to know why it works, and how it could be ten times better. You want to get better every single day, and you treat feedback as fuel rather than criticism. You take ownership: when something breaks, you fix it; when something is unclear, you go and find out. You have a solid grasp of backend and software fundamentals (Python, APIs, databases) or the raw learning capacity to pick them up in weeks. You will probably recognise yourself in most of this: You build with AI every day: Claude, Cursor, Lovable, agents, APIs, whatever gets you there fastest. You can show us concrete proof of work, not just tell us about it. You move fast without being sloppy, and you care about the details the customer sees. You are comfortable not knowing the answer, and you find it quickly. You communicate clearly in English, in writing and out loud. What we do not require: a degree, a minimum age, years of experience or a perfect CV. If you are still in school or university, we will make it work around that. What you get: The honest pitch: you will learn more here in one year than in five years almost anywhere else , because you will be building real systems for a real company that is reinventing itself, with the people who are leading that change. A contract from day one. The Residency is your first year at HelloPrint, not a trial period or an internship. Direct access to the founders and to a senior AI development team who review your work and push you. Ownership from day one : your name on projects that change how a €100M+ company runs. The best tools, no budget debates : the newest models, coding agents and frameworks, as soon as they are worth using. A growth path that follows your output, not your age : if you outgrow your role in six months, your role grows with you. A fast, flat, no-politics team in Rotterdam, with a hands-on culture and a high bar. Flexible set-up : full-time, or part-time alongside your studies. We care about what you deliver. Salary and contract are tailored to your situation and your level, and we pay properly for real talent. How to apply: Skip the cover letter. Show us what you have built. Send us three things: Your best project : a link to something you built: a live product, a repo, a demo video. Tell us in a few sentences what it does and what you would do differently now. Something you think is broken : one thing about HelloPrint (our website, our ordering flow, anything) that you would rebuild with AI, and how you would do it. A short intro : who you are and what you are obsessed with right now. Five sentences is plenty. What happens next: We read every application ourselves and reply within 5 days

jobs.jd: Robots are about to step out of the movies and into our homes. If you're excited about this robotics revolution, come join Amazon's Fauna Robotics. jobs.title: Fulfillment Technology Analyst
jobs.jd:
Job Description

As the Fulfillment Technology Analyst, you will drive the implementation, support, and continuous improvement of our strategic Warehouse Management System across distribution facilities, starting with our Warehouse Solution 2.0 roll-out at our Sydney Warehouse based in Eastern Creek. Sitting in the Fulfillment Technology team and collaborating closely with local operations and global technology teams, you will serve as a key bridge between technology solutions and daily warehouse operations.

This is a fantastic opportunity for someone at the start of their career who is an executor, thrives on solving problems independently, and wants to be part of rolling out systems.

This role is based in Eastern Creek, Sydney, and reports to the International Director WMS Support and Operations who is based in the UK.

You will…

  • Act as super user and level one support for the warehouse end-user community, supporting technical and functional issues in a live, fast-paced DC environment.
  • Drive SQL query writing and database updates to investigate, troubleshoot, and solve operational issues across the WMS and integrated upstream/downstream systems.
  • Execute technical User Acceptance Testing (UAT) and validate software configurations and upgrade releases to ensure continuous site operation.
  • Move away from manual, reactive fixes by building sustainable processes, documentation, SOPs, and self-service solutions.
  • Leverage modern AI tools (e.g., Cursor, Claude) to automate repetitive tasks, improve testing coverage, and optimize workflows.
  • Participate in a "follow-the-sun" global support model covering operations spanning Sydney to Europe and the US.
  • Manage user menu profiles, security setups, hardware devices (RF scanners, tablets, workstations), and local network service coordination.

You have/are…

  • 1+ years of experience supporting WMS in an RF-based distribution, manufacturing, or e-commerce fulfillment environment.
  • Practical SQL proficiency to query, update databases, and analyze system data independently.
  • A self-starter who operates with high independence across time zones and multi-threaded challenges.
  • Demonstrated technical and operational problem-solving capability in dynamic, fast-paced warehouse environments.
  • Strong communicator who actively collaborates with cross-functional operational, tech, and production planning teams.
  • Willingness to travel internationally (e.g., Europe or US) during onboarding and quarterly team syncs.

What you’ll get in return… 

  • The chance to have a significant impact in a leading global food technology company
  • Flexible working arrangements 
  • Egoless environment, constant learning with room for personal growth
  • Free access to Headspace
  • Internal learning & development 
  • A diverse and vibrant international environment, with offices in 18 countries
  • Company discount - 70% off HelloFresh & 40% off Youfoodz

Start Date: Immediately available - Can wait a notice period

Location: Eastern Creek - Parking On site 

Salary: Competitive salary & employee benefits

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer – SAP (m/f/d)
jobs.location: Berlin, with travel across DACH Germany
jobs.jd: About Qorelo Almost every company running SAP faces the same task: the move to SAP S/4HANA. These programmes run for years, cost tens of millions, and regularly stall at the same point. Nobody fully understands the legacy landscape that has grown over decades. That is where Qorelo comes in. We are building the AI platform for S/4HANA transformation. Qorelo reads code, processes, documentation and how the system is actually used, makes the existing landscape transparent, and delivers the fit-to-standard analysis in weeks instead of months. We take a clean core, target-architecture-first approach and carry it end to end across SAP Activate, from Discover to Realize. The knowledge stays with the customer afterwards, long after the system integrators have moved on. We have raised $3.5M from HPI Ventures, the fund tied to the institute of SAP co-founder Hasso Plattner, along with other strong backers. We already work with Fortune 500 and DAX 40 companies, including Mercedes-Benz. The role As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you are Qorelo’s technical face at the customer. You run workshops and demos on the customer’s real SAP landscape, get Qorelo connected to their systems and tools, and make sure the platform delivers on their data and their processes. Then you bring what you learned back to our engineers. You work directly with our engineering team and solution architects, report to Marino, our CTO, and spend a real share of your time with customers, both on site and remotely. What you will own SAP connectivity. RFC connections, technical users and authorisations. You make the connection work and explain it to Basis and security teams in their language. Workshops and demos on real environments. You run on-site workshops of several hours and show Qorelo on the customer’s own SAP landscape, not a sandbox: their custom code, their processes, their data. You prepare together with sales and our solution architects, and you handle the technical questions in the room. Integrations. You connect the customer’s tools to Qorelo through our existing integrations across the SAP, Atlassian, Microsoft and similar ecosystems, and make sure they work on the customer’s landscape. The feedback loop. What you see at customers (where the product wins, where it falls short, what they asked for) comes back to engineering and product as clear, concrete feedback. You are the engineering team’s eyes and ears at the customer. What you need 5+ years in technical, customer-facing roles around SAP: technical SAP consultant, solutions or presales engineer, or an engineer who spent much of their time with customers. Solid SAP technical understanding: you know how an SAP landscape fits together (ECC, S/4HANA), what RFC connections, technical users and authorisations are, and what a Basis team will ask you. You do not need to be an ABAP developer. Enough technical depth to set up and troubleshoot a connection with the customer’s IT: credentials, firewalls, proxies, VPN, certificates. Strong presence in the room: you can run a five-hour workshop with consultants, IT leads and process owners, demo live on their system, and keep it on track when something does not work. Real AI curiosity: you use LLM tools yourself and can explain clearly what Qorelo does and where its limits are. Willingness to travel within Europe for on-site demos and workshops. Fluent English. German is a plus for our DACH client base. You might be a fit if You have been the person customers want in the room for the demo, and the one consultants call when the connection does not work. You have worked at an SAP consultancy, system integrator or SAP software vendor and want to be closer to a product. You enjoy a full day of workshops at a customer and can still explain clearly afterwards what worked, what did not and why. You have taken software through an enterprise IT and security onboarding and know why it takes as long as it does. What we offer Real ownership . Meaningful equity and a direct hand in how Qorelo runs in the field. We are looking for people who want to shape a company, not join one. Competitive salary , benchmarked for senior customer-facing technical talent in Berlin. The problems. Fortune 500 and DAX 40 production landscapes, including Mercedes-Benz. You work at the core of SAP systems most engineers never get to touch. The team. Short paths, fast decisions, and a direct line to our CTO, our founding engineer and our solution architects. 25 days paid vacation + German public holidays. Company offsites with the whole team. An office at the Wasserturm in Prenzlauer Berg – where you work when you are not with customers. The fridge is stocked. Wellhub membership , top-tier equipment and access to the latest AI tools. Hiring process Intro call with Gaspar, our founding engineer (30 min) Deep dive on your SAP and customer-facing background with Marino, our CTO (60 min) Practical case: a workshop and live demo simulation with our engineers and solution architects Offer How to apply Send us your CV at Qorelo is an equal opportunity employer. As a Delivery Lead, you will own delivery of priority AI initiatives for these customers, leading complex, high-impact deployments from planning through launch and adoption. You’ll partner closely with account and technical teams, FDEs, customers, and delivery partners to turn customer priorities into successful deployments. You’ll bring a clear view of delivery progress, risks, and expected outcomes, helping teams make informed decisions and connecting successful execution to consumption and growth. This is a senior, customer-facing role for someone who can move between executive conversations and practical details that determine whether a deployment succeeds. You bring technical fluency, sound judgment, and the ability to create clarity and drive action in complex, evolving environments. WHAT YOU’LL DO - Own delivery of priority AI initiatives. jobs.title: Applied Scientist , Fauna
jobs.jd: We are seeking an Applied Scientist to develop and optimize Visual Inertial Odometry (VIO) and sensor fusion systems for our intelligent robots. In this role, you will design, implement, and deploy state estimation and tracking algorithms that enable robots to understand their position and motion in real time, even in challenging and dynamic environments. You will own the full pipeline from algorithm development through embedded deployment, ensuring that perception systems run efficiently on resource-constrained robotic hardware. You will also leverage modern machine learning approaches to push the boundaries of classical perception methods, combining learned representations with geometric techniques to achieve robust, real-time performance. This is a deeply hands-on role. You will work directly with sensors, hardware, and real-world data, while prototyping, testing, and iterating in physical environments.
